messages:
Kaitlin (ACME): Hey — trying to sign up for the free trial. The sign-up flow forces me to add a card and the card auth keeps failing with a 3DS error. UI shows: "Payment required: 3DS_challenge_failed". I tried two different cards. Any ideas?

Maya (Support): Sorry about that — we can help. Can you DM me the email on the account and last4? Also any error request id shown in the UI?

Kaitlin (ACME): DMed you. Request id on the error modal: req_7f9c2a. Last4: 4242.

payments-bot: Webhook log for req_7f9c2a: status=challenge_required, provider=Stripe, code=3ds_challenge_required, acs_url=https://acs.bank.example/challenge?id=abc123, response_time_ms=850.

Eli (SRE): Paging in payments. Maya — can you share reproduction steps and the network trace? We want the gateway request/response.

Maya (Support): Repro steps from customer flow: 1) Customer enters card during onboarding (card_on_file flow). 2) Frontend posts to our billing API: POST /v1/billing/start_trial 
headers + body include payment_method=pm_1Hxxxx. 3) Billing service forwards to Stripe -> Stripe returns { status: 'requires_action', next_action: { type: 'use_stripe_sdk', redirect_to_url: 'https://acs.bank.example/...' } } 4) Frontend opens challenge in a webview/iframe; the bank returns a redirect loop or the frame blocks cookies -> challenge fails -> final status 'payment_method_authentication_failed' -> UI surfaces 3DS_challenge_failed.

Samir (Billing): This looks like a classic 3DS iframe cookie issue (embedded webviews / strict SameSite or CSP blocking the ACS domain). We've seen it with some enterprise SSO setups where third-party cookies are blocked. Two options:
- Short-term: grant trial credits manually so the customer can proceed while we fix the flow.
- Long-term: adjust our frontend to open ACS in a top-level navigation or provide a redirect flow, plus provide guidance to customers about 3rd-party cookie settings.

Eli (SRE): Can you paste the exact Stripe error object? Also any browser console logs about cookie blocked or frame-ancestors?

payments-bot: Stripe event: {
  "id": "evt_3JkXyL",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "pm_1Hxxxx",
      "status": "requires_action",
      "next_action": {"type":"redirect_to_url","redirect_to_url":{"url":"https://acs.bank.example/challenge?id=abc123"}}
    }
  }
}

Kaitlin (ACME): Console shows: "Refused to display 'https://acs.bank.example/' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'DENY'" and also "SameSite cookie blocked" in Chrome. We use an internal SSO wrapper that forces stricter headers.

Maya (Support): Thanks — that explains it. For now we can grant the 14-day trial and 1000 free credits to Kaitlin's account so they can continue. Are we ok with manual grant given PCI notes?

Samir (Billing): Yes. Use billing-admin tool to create a non-billing trial flag and a credit ledger entry. Command we use internally: 
```
# internal admin tool (audit logged)
billing-admin grant_trial --account acme-corp --days 14 --credits 1000 --actor maya@redwood.ai --reason "3DS iframe/cookie failure preventing trial"
```
Note: do NOT store card details in support messages. All card interactions remain in PCI scope and are handled by the payments provider.

Maya (Support): I'll run that now and paste the audit id.

Maya (Support): Done. Audit id: audit_20260305_42. Customer account now flagged with trial_exemption until 2026-03-19 and 1000 trial credits added. I also attached a private note to the account: "3DS challenge fails in iframe due to SSO; developer guidance sent."

Eli (SRE): I'll file a follow-up with the frontend team to default to top-level redirects for 3DS or detect blocked frames and fallback. Samir — can you open a vendor ticket with Stripe including evt_3JkXyL and req_7f9c2a?

Samir (Billing): On it. Filing ticket with Stripe now — linking logs and customer's debug info. Ticket ref: STR-987654.

Maya (Support): Kaitlin — you should be able to continue signup now. Can you retry and confirm?

Kaitlin (ACME): Just retried — onboarding accepted, trial started. Thanks so much! :tada:

Maya (Support): Great. We'll keep the ticket open until Stripe confirms root cause. I'll add the recommended guidance to our docs: "If 3DS challenge fails in embedded frames, open ACS in top-level navigation or instruct customer to allow third-party cookies."

Eli (SRE): Internal follow-up tasks:
- eng-frontend: detect 'requires_action' + failed challenge -> fallback to top-level redirect (P1).
- docs: add Troubleshooting 3DS/iframe note.
- payments: monitor STR-987654 and confirm if any provider-side mitigation is needed.

Samir (Billing): Marking this thread resolved for customer. Will update once Stripe responds. :white_check_mark:

Kaitlin (ACME): Appreciated!"
